component.name: Nox
component.summary: Edit videos with GPU compositing and HDR export
Videos bearbeiten, mit GPU-Compositing und HDR-Export

description.p: Nox is a video editor for GNOME. Clips are decoded, composited and graded on the GPU with Vulkan, and exports go straight from the GPU to hardware encoders.
Nox ist ein Videoeditor für GNOME. Clips werden mit Vulkan auf der GPU dekodiert, zusammengesetzt und farbkorrigiert, und Exporte gehen direkt von der GPU zu Hardware-Encodern.

ul.li: Multi-track timeline with transitions, fades, speed changes and keyframes
Timeline mit mehreren Spuren, Übergängen, Blenden, Geschwindigkeit und Keyframes
Color grading with color wheels and scopes
SDR, HDR10 and HLG export in H.264, HEVC and ProRes
Export in SDR, HDR10 und HLG als H.264, HEVC und ProRes
Hardware encoding with Vulkan Video and NVENC
Hardware-Kodierung mit Vulkan Video und NVENC
Projects in the open OpenTimelineIO format

description.p: Subtitles are a track type of their own, in every format FFmpeg reads: SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, MP4 text, and Blu-ray, DVD and DVB bitmap subtitles. They show in the viewer and export as subtitle streams, or burned into the picture.

ul.li: Import Subtitles adds a file's or a subtitle file's subtitles on a subtitle track, timed with the selected clip; text subtitles can be turned into styled text clips
Adding a file with several video, audio or subtitle streams asks which of them to use
Exports keep audio tracks as separate streams on request, and tag audio and subtitle streams with their language and title
Text can have a border and a shadow
The timeline scrolls vertically when its tracks don't fit, and follows the playhead during playback

description.p: Whole folders can be dropped onto the media pool: Nox imports the video, audio and image files in them and their subfolders, leaving out hidden ones.

Nox now always uses the dark style, and the Flatpak asks for fewer permissions: only the graphics devices, and only the Videos, Music and Pictures folders. Media from elsewhere is opened through the file chooser or drag and drop, and projects still save its real location.
